lines.text: The churches of Macedonia had abundant joy and deep poverty, and these overflowed into rich generosity.
The Macedonians pleaded for the privilege of sharing in the service, and they gave themselves first to the elders.
Paul urged Titus to help complete the Corinthians' act of grace and told them to excel in giving.
Though Jesus was rich, for the Corinthians' sake He became poor, so that through His poverty they might become wise.
Paul told the Corinthians to finish the work, so that their surplus and the others' surplus would bring equality.
